nEn: Sleeping on brushwood and tasting gall
mean: 越王勾践卧柴草、尝苦胆自励，终灭吴复国。
meanEn: King Goujian of Yue endured hardship to avenge himself and destroy Wu.

nEn: Amaze the world with a single cry
mean: 楚庄王三年不理政，一旦发力便成就霸业。
meanEn: King Zhuang of Chu, silent for three years, then rose to hegemony.

nEn: Retreat ninety li
mean: 晋文公重耳流亡受楚恩，许诺交战时退避三舍。
meanEn: Duke Wen of Jin repaid a debt by retreating ninety li before battle.

nEn: Besiege Wei to rescue Zhao
mean: 孙膑攻其必救，避实击虚解赵之围。
meanEn: Sun Bin struck the enemy's weak point to lift the siege of Zhao.

nEn: Discuss war on paper
mean: 赵括空谈兵法，长平之战大败。
meanEn: Zhao Kuo's bookish tactics led to disaster at Changping.

nEn: Return the jade intact to Zhao
mean: 蔺相如不辱使命，完璧归赵。
meanEn: Lin Xiangru returned the jade to Zhao, mission accomplished.

nEn: Bare one's back for punishment
mean: 廉颇负荆向蔺相如请罪，成就「将相和」。
meanEn: Lian Po apologized to Lin Xiangru, sealing the general–minister bond.

nEn: The map unrolled, the dagger revealed
mean: 荆轲献图刺秦王，图尽而匕首现。
meanEn: Jing Ke's plot was exposed when the map unrolled to reveal a dagger.

nEn: Mao Sui recommends himself
mean: 门客毛遂主动请缨，随平原君出使楚国。
meanEn: The retainer Mao Sui volunteered for a mission to Chu.

nEn: Call a deer a horse
mean: 赵高献鹿称马，试探并压制群臣。
meanEn: Zhao Gao tested the court by calling a deer a horse.

nEn: Burn the books, bury the scholars
mean: 秦始皇焚书坑儒，钳制思想。
meanEn: Qin Shi Huang suppressed dissent by burning books and burying scholars.

nEn: Break the cauldrons, sink the boats
mean: 项羽断绝退路，巨鹿之战大破秦军。
meanEn: Xiang Yu cut off retreat to crush Qin at Julu.

nEn: Chu songs on every side
mean: 项羽被围垓下，四面皆闻楚歌，军心涣散。
meanEn: Surrounded at Gaixia, Xiang Yu's army broke on hearing Chu songs all around.

nEn: Fight with one's back to the river
mean: 韩信背水列阵，置之死地而后生。
meanEn: Han Xin arrayed his troops with their backs to the river, winning by daring.

nEn: Agree on a three-article law
mean: 刘邦入关，约法三章，安定民心。
meanEn: Liu Bang won hearts by simplifying law to three articles.

nEn: Bore a hole in the wall for light
srcEn: Miscellaneous Records of the Western Capital
mean: 匡衡凿壁借邻舍烛光苦读。
meanEn: Kuang Heng studied by the light he let in through a chink in the wall.

nEn: Three visits to the thatched cottage
mean: 刘备三顾茅庐，诚请诸葛亮出山。
meanEn: Liu Bei thrice sought out Zhuge Liang to serve him.

nEn: Quench thirst by thinking of plums
srcEn: A New Account of Tales of the World
mean: 曹操以「前有梅林」鼓舞行军士气。
meanEn: Cao Cao raised morale by invoking a plum grove ahead.

nEn: So happy as to forget home
mean: 刘禅降魏后沉迷安乐，不复思蜀。
meanEn: The fallen ruler Liu Shan forgot Shu in his new comfort.

nEn: Every bush and tree looks like an enemy
mean: 淝水之战，苻坚望八公山草木皆以为兵。
meanEn: At Fei River, Fu Jian saw soldiers in every bush.

nEn: Return from the Eastern Mountain
mean: 谢安隐居东山后再度出仕，成一代名相。
meanEn: Xie An returned from reclusion to become a famed statesman.

nEn: Please step into the cauldron
srcEn: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance
mean: 来俊臣以周兴之酷法反治周兴。
meanEn: A cruel interrogator was undone by his own method.

nEn: Draped in the yellow robe
mean: 赵匡胤陈桥兵变，被拥立为帝。
meanEn: Zhao Kuangyin was made emperor at Chenqiao.

nEn: Serve the country with utter loyalty
mean: 岳飞背刺「尽忠报国」，矢志抗金。
meanEn: Yue Fei bore the vow “repay the country with loyalty” on his back.
